title: NCCIH U01 COMBINI award as MPI
content: Dr. Zhang received a new U01 as MPI from NCCIH entitled "COMBINI: connecting Complementary Medicine evidence and Biological kNowledge to support Integrative Health."

title: NIDDK R01 on racial disparities in kidney transplantation
content: Dr. Zhang received a new R01 project from NIDDK as MPI entitled "Racial disparities in access to kidney transplantation."

title: NIHMD R21 for AllofUs data modeling
content: Dr. Zhang received a new R21 project from NIHMD as contact PI with Drs. Jinghua Huang and Jue Hou entitled "Mining minority enriched AllofUs data for innovative ethnic specific risk prediction modeling."

title: NCI R01 on learning from imbalanced biomedical data
content: Dr. Zhang received R01 project 1R01CA287413‑01 from NCI as MPI with Drs. Ju Sun and Ying Cui entitled "SCH: A New Computational Framework for Learning from Imbalanced Biomedical Data."

title: Renewal R01 on dietary supplements informatics
content: Dr. Zhang received a renewal R01 project as PI from NCCIH (2R01AT009457): "A Translational Informatics Framework to Mine Efficacy and Safety of Dietary Supplements," total cost $3.1 million.
